cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. We'll both remember the result.

mechanism: A persuades a captain to stake the role for a shorter period and adds shared risk while keeping the rematch consequential.
confusable: Unlike merely boasting about a rematch, A negotiates an actual larger commitment beyond pride.
comparison: Temporary captaincy and A equipment duty differ from chess deciding weekend meals.
seedUse: D200-b captaincy and forgotten pride results; S02-b narrows duration and stakes A own work to keep B willing.
